title: Polynomial-time cursor and instance projections
statement: There is a polynomial-time algorithm that, from any Boolean word $z$, outputs the unary word whose length is the current emission cursor encoded in $z$. There is also a polynomial-time algorithm that outputs the retained instance encoded in $z$.
hypotheses_covered: No additional hypotheses; the conclusion asserts both stated functions are polynomial-time computable
replaced: The unary current cursor and the retained original instance are both polynomial-time computable projections of the persistent body word.
